subject: Symphony Series: CloudFusion x Redwood — regional demo + webinar planning

Subject: Symphony Series: CloudFusion x Redwood - Q3 regional demo + webinar proposal

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from CloudFusion partnerships — we loved Redwood's demo at DataStack West and think there's great resonance with our mid-market pipeline. We'd like to propose a short series (we're calling it the "Symphony Series") of: a 60-minute technical webinar (panel + demo) and a one-day regional field demo in Austin (booth + 3x paired 20-min demos) targeted at 100-150 prospects.

High-level asks from our side:
- Shared webinar promotion (email + social + 1 co-branded landing page)
- MDF to cover regional venue and local demand-gen ($12k target contribution from CloudFusion — looking for Redwood to match or provide credit)
- Technical co-ownership of the demo content (Aditya, would you be the internal technical lead?)

Would love to schedule a 30–45min planning call next week to align scope and get an SOW started. Attached is a very rough outline (Symphony_Draft_SOW_v1.pdf) to help the convo.

Available times: Tue 3/3 10–12 CT, Wed 3/4 9–11 CT, Thu 3/5 2–4 CT.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Yoon
Director, Partnerships | CloudFusion
partnerships@cloudfusion.io

Subject: Re: Symphony Series: CloudFusion x Redwood - Q3 regional demo + webinar proposal

Sara — thanks, love the framing.

Quick responses and asks:
- We can commit to the webinar (Redwood will provide 2 speakers + a product demo). Marketing support: we can do co-branded email (1 nurture + 1 reminder), social, and host the landing page.
- MDF: we typically require a simple cost-share (50/50) for venue + local ads for events of this size; can we see CloudFusion's line-item budget? If you want credits instead of cash, we can consider up to $6k in marketing credit against future CPL programs — would need approval from finance (looping in Marissa).
- Technical lead: Aditya is good to own the demo build and pre-demo dry run.

Can you attach a line-item budget and the audience target list? If you already have a finalized MOU template, please share or we can draft.

I'll schedule a 30-min planning call for Wed 3/4 9:30 CT and share a calendar invite; if that doesn't work, choose another slot from your times.

—Kimberly

Kimberly / Sara,

Joining — Ben (field marketing). A few logistics notes from the ops side for the Austin one-day:
- Venue: we usually budget $6k–10k for a 100–150 person demo day (space + AV). If CloudFusion can cover $6k and Redwood covers $6k we hit the midpoint.
- Booth: 6x10 table, 2x demo stations, 3 presenters staggered. We recommend 1 senior SE + 1 AE from each company for the demo window.
- Staffing: Redwood can field 2 FTEs (SE + AM) for the day; need travel approvals for out-of-region folks.
- Lead flow: we'll push leads into Salesforce (please confirm the required fields).

I've attached our field ops workback (field_ops_workback.xlsx) with a proposed staffing timeline and travel cutoff dates.
